The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a '''supply base''' on the [[Jade Moon]]. The hub was protected by a [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|DSS-02]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]], with the generator in a nearby canyon. Another building held advanced shield technology. A [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE series/Legends|TIEs]] was available for defense, and [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|XX-9 heavy turbolasers]] and [[missile turret]]s were spread around the hub.<ref name="RS I" /> More than six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="RS I guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> the Imperial defector [[Kasan Moor/Legends|Kasan Moor]] led the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] flight group [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to [[Battle of the Jade Moon|raid]] the supply hub.<ref name="RS I" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)}}
[[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed the building which held the shield technology and acquired the technology.<ref name="RS I" />
{{Endgame}}

After Skywalker destroyed the shield generator, the Rebel's [[combat vehicle]]s raided the hub for its supplies.<ref name="RS I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The supply base appears in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]. Acquiring the technology is necessary for the mission's gold medal, and this article assumes the player did so.
